Name: (AT) Tenthousandcats' Firefly Lamps
Author: beyondrecovery
Description:
[center][size=4][b]**Now updated for Alternative Textures**[/b][/size][size=3][/size][/center][size=3]
Hello everyone! I have gone ahead and finally updated the conversion to AT since DGA is obsolete.

This is an AT conversion of tenthousandcats' Firefly Lamps, which can be found [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/896856-firefly-lamps]here[/url]. She has kindly granted me permission to upload this conversion <3 [size=3]Like the originals, these are also animated! [/size]
[/size][size=3]
[b]Please note[/b]: [u]These are NOT standalone furniture anymore[/u], but rather an alternative texture of the base game's Wood Lamp Post. Both the lamp post and the paint bucket used to retexture it can be purchased from Robin's shop.[/size]


[size=3][size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿[/b].
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.
[*]Launch your game, and get ready to bask in the glow of fireflies!
[/list]

[b]ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS[/b]

PeacefulEnd, the creator of AT[/size][size=3].
many thanks to tenthousandcats for allowing me to upload this conversion. To support more of her work, visit her page [b][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/113115]here[/url][/b].
[/size]
